_comment: Bundle-size budgets in gzipped kB (REQUIREMENTS.md §13.5). Enforced by
`npm run budget`, which CI runs after the build — a regression fails the
build rather than being noticed later.
Groups are filename prefixes, not exact names: Vite fingerprints its output.
Raising a budget is fine when the growth is deliberate — do it in the same
commit as the change, so the increase is reviewed alongside what caused it.
_cmmn_note: assets/CmmnEditor went 12 -> 14 with the canvas work: auto-layout for cases
that arrive with no CMMNDI, in-place renaming, and clone-with-rewired-references
behind copy/paste/duplicate. All three are code rather than copy, and all three
are in the lazily loaded editor chunk, which is where they belong.
_index_note: assets/index went 72 -> 78 when the CMMN panel gained the ~60 attribute and
field labels the engine reads (P1). It is user-facing copy in the message
catalogue, which every app loads at startup, so it lands in the entry chunk
rather than in CmmnEditor. Splitting catalogues per feature would put it
where it belongs; that is a change to how I18nProvider is fed, not to this
file, and is not worth doing for 2 kB on its own.
_shared_chunk_note: assets/src is the shared chunk the bundler hoists out of the lazily loaded editors.
It had no group, so nothing bounded it individually and `assets/index` read low
(38 kB) because most of the entry's code lives here. Only totalKb was holding it.
